hotspots.name: Iran war & Persian Gulf
hotspots.summary: On 22 Nov Bahrain said two people were injured in Saturday's Iranian attacks, one critically, and Saudi Arabia condemned the strike on a Bahraini industrial site and warned Iran it would bear the consequences if such attacks continued; Bloomberg reports the UK government has been preparing for possible renewed US strikes on Iran. Late on 21 Nov Iran fired missiles and drones at US positions in Bahrain: the IRGC said it hit two US Patriot radars at the al-Riffa and Awali bases in response to US MQ-1 and MQ-9 flights over Iran, while Bahrain said it intercepted several attacks and one caused a fire at a civilian industrial facility with no injuries; neither Bahrain nor the US confirmed damage to the bases, and explosions were later reported in Sirik. At least three tankers were attacked in or near Hormuz on 21 Nov, including a stern hit about 11 nm north of Khasab reported by UKMTO, whose weekly overview counted 263 transits in the week to 18 Nov, about 65% below pre-war, with six tanker attacks. More than 14 Iranian tankers are gathered off Kharg Island to run the US naval blockade toward China; Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi called the blockade an act of war and Iran threatened a 'fierce military response' and attacks on Gulf energy facilities if the convoy is engaged, while Kayhan's editor urged strikes on undersea cables. Araghchi says Hormuz can reopen if the US meets Iran's conditions, including ending the blockade and lifting sanctions, and rules out shipping 60% enriched uranium abroad; a Qatari delegation held talks in Tehran on 20 Nov and CENTCOM's Adm. Cooper met Qatar's defence minister in Doha. Trump told Fox News he wants a 'permanent' deal and will not decide on new strikes until the new year; CBS reports Israel prefers a joint operation. Treasury sanctioned four Iranian 'oil trustees', and Kpler puts Hormuz crude flows at about half pre-war levels.

hotspots.name: Israel, Gaza & Lebanon
hotspots.summary: On 21 Nov President Aoun demanded Israel withdraw from 'every inch' of Lebanon, stop its attacks and return detainees, decried interference by parts of the Iranian regime and told Hezbollah to hand over its weapons, as Israeli strikes hit the Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil and Marjayoun districts, including Baraachit and Kfar Tebnit. In Gaza an air strike killed three in Gaza City on 21 Nov after six were killed in Bureij, Deir al-Balah and Nuseirat on 20 Nov, and Board of Peace adviser Josh Gruenbaum warned the body would 'hand the keys' to the UN if Israel keeps blocking reconstruction. Israel said on 19 Nov it had concluded its largest ground incursion into central Gaza since the truce, beyond the Yellow Line, and reopened Salah al-Din road; about 6,000 people fled and Hamas called it a ceasefire violation. Israeli strikes and shelling hit the Nabatieh area, Qantara and near Khiam in south Lebanon on 19 Nov. Israel struck what it called a Hezbollah-bound weapons shipment in the Janta area of the Bekaa Valley near the Syrian border early on 16 Nov, its first strike there in months, and Lebanon says Israeli troops detained two brothers near Shebaa. Israeli jets struck Kfar Tibnit and several other southern Lebanon villages on 9 Nov, and Israeli forces shelled Haddatha on 14 Nov, despite the June framework deal on a gradual Israeli withdrawal; on 10 Nov unidentified attackers fired at a UNIFIL patrol near Wadi Jilu. Lebanon's Health Ministry says Israeli attacks since 2 March have killed 4,390 people. In Gaza, an Israeli drone strike killed two people in Jabaliya on 14 Nov after tank fire killed three in Deir al-Balah and a baby died of cold on 13 Nov; the EU is urging Israel to let in flood aid and reopen all crossings. In Israel, caretaker PM Netanyahu renewed his call on 14 Nov for a unity government to 'eliminate the Iranian threat once and for all', which Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a government, rejected. Near Damascus, a car bomb killed a man and his daughter in Jaramana. On 18 Nov the US-backed Board of Peace warned the UN Security Council the Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse, the Israeli army said it dismantled a Hezbollah tunnel with living quarters near Mount Dov, and the US Treasury sanctioned a Hezbollah-linked charity and a gold network accused of moving Quds Force funds. Israel has asked Lebanon, via US mediators, to keep Hezbollah out of any renewed Iran war.

hotspots.summary: Overnight on 22 Nov Russia launched 186 drones, of which Ukraine says 161 were downed or suppressed; one destroyed a five-storey apartment building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, killing at least two and wounding four, with 11 people believed trapped in the rubble. Russia kept up its air campaign after the 20 Nov mass strike, which Ukrainian officials say involved more than 80 missiles and 400 drones: a ballistic-missile and Shahed double-tap on a restaurant car park in central Kryvyi Rih late on 20 Nov killed a seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic and injured more than 40, and overnight on 21 Nov Russia fired three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, setting homes on fire in Kyiv's Podil district; the Kyiv Independent counts at least two killed and 83 injured in a day. The 20 Nov barrage hit three Kyiv bridges and killed at least seven in the capital and two at Lviv's Sknyliv station. Poland confirmed a Kh-101 cruise missile came down at Nowy Lipowiec, with a second missile or drone near Rudnik nad Sanem and a jet drone near Mołodycz, and no one hurt; Tusk called it a deliberate provocation, France requested a UN Security Council meeting, and NATO's Rutte said in Warsaw on 21 Nov that the alliance 'will defend every inch of Polish territory'. Putin has vowed a 'painful' response to Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge and ruled out energy or Black Sea truce talks, while the FT reports Washington wants a peace deal by early January.

hotspots.name: Yemen & Red Sea

Saudi Arabia issued eight emergency alerts in 24 hours. The Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port on 20 Nov after telling civilians to evacuate, in what it called a 'special operation' against weapons and missile smuggling, and also hit missile and drone sites and a supply depot in Sanaa and targets in Saada and Taiz; the Houthis say coalition strikes killed 41 people in 24 hours, a figure not independently confirmed, and Yemen's information minister says the port remains operational. The coalition said it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Jazan, with debris falling in Al-Shuqaiq, after the Houthis named the Al-Shuqaiq power plant, Jeddah, Yanbu and all Saudi Red Sea ports and Riyadh's financial district as targets, declared Saudi airspace unsafe except over Mecca and Medina, and told shipping lines to pull their ships out of Saudi Red Sea ports. The UN urged restraint and said Yemen's Red Sea ports must stay open. Houthi missile fire damaged Riyadh's PIF Tower on 19 Nov, and Reuters reported Saudi Arabia expects the war to last into 2027. news.headline: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse

news.summary: The UN rights office counted more than 1,630 civilians killed by drones from January to October as the army closed to about 60 km of the RSF-held city of Al-Nuhud; a drone strike blamed on the army killed at least 16 displaced people sheltering in a school in Ghabish.

news.headline: Ukraine strikes the Crimean Bridge again, two days after a span collapsed
news.summary: Crimea's Moscow-installed head Sergey Aksyonov confirmed the bridge was hit just after midnight; car traffic was already suspended after the 17 Nov collapse, and experts say repairs could take a year or more.

news.headline: Ukrainian drones reportedly set Tatarstan oil pumping station ablaze
news.summary: Monitoring channels say the Kaleykino station near Almetyevsk was hit overnight, as Reuters reports Ukrainian strikes over 20 days have disrupted or halted 15 of Russia's 35 major refineries and cut processing by about 45%.

news.headline: IEA calls the Gulf crisis the largest threat to energy security in history
news.summary: In its annual World Energy Outlook the agency said the war and Hormuz disruption pose an unprecedented risk to supply, even as oil prices sit near three-month lows on expectations of a surplus.

news.headline: Riyadh's 80-storey PIF Tower damaged as Houthis target the financial district
news.summary: Witnesses told AFP the facade was damaged across several floors after the coalition said it 'addressed a missile threat' to Riyadh, blaming debris; no casualties were reported, and the Houthis said they fired cruise missiles at the airport and financial centre.

news.headline: Trump still weighing joint US–Israeli strikes on Iran, Israeli outlet reports
news.summary: Mako, citing two sources, said no decision will come before Trump returns from Asia; Trump claimed Iran is looking at chemical and biological weapons and said any response may wait until after 1 January.

news.headline: Xi tells Trump the US should do 'the right thing' on Taiwan
news.summary: In their Shenzhen bilateral Xi warned of setbacks in relations if Washington mishandles Taiwan, while describing ties as broadly stable and agreeing to improve communication on trade.

news.headline: IRGC claims two supertankers exploded after hitting mines in Hormuz
news.summary: The Guards said the ships, carrying more than 4 million barrels, used an unauthorised route and were abandoned; there is no independent confirmation, and UKMTO separately reported a tanker hit in the engine room north of Khasab on 18 Nov with all crew safe.

news.headline: First Trump–Xi–Putin summit agrees on nuclear risk and UN reform, but no breakthroughs
news.summary: A short joint statement in Shenzhen did not mention Ukraine or Iran; Trump said he raised both in separate talks and that the three share an interest in keeping Hormuz open.

news.headline: Somalia orders the UAE ambassador out within 72 hours, citing an "invasion"
news.summary: Somalia's cabinet expelled the Emirati envoy and recalled its own ambassador, accusing Abu Dhabi of setting up military bases without federal approval; the UAE called the move escalatory and hostile.

news.headline: Hungary lifts its block on the next steps of Ukraine's and Moldova's EU bids
news.summary: Diplomats say Budapest dropped its objection to opening the last two negotiating clusters, with a formal opening now expected in December.

news.headline: Putin rules out energy and Black Sea truce talks after Crimean Bridge strikes
news.summary: Putin said Russia will no longer discuss ceasefires on energy infrastructure and Black Sea shipping and promised a response 'far more painful' than Ukraine's attacks on the bridge.

news.headline: Trump says he is 'not rushing' an Iran strike decision and will wait until the new year
news.summary: Trump told Axios and Channel 12 'we will see what happens after the beginning of the year', while US officials were reported sceptical of Netanyahu's push for renewed war.

news.headline: Hours-long Russian drone raid on Kyiv damages Dutch and Austrian embassies and St Volodymyr's Cathedral
news.summary: One man was killed and five injured in Podilskyi district; embassy staff were unhurt and the cathedral’s cornices were damaged.

news.headline: China now requires export licences for drone engines and other parts used in Russian drones
news.summary: Rules in force since 18 Nov cover jet and electric drone engines, radio modules, speed controllers and heavy motors; Kyiv's sanctions envoy calls it 'a start' as navigation modules and antennas are left out.

news.headline: Trump tells Berlin meeting that 'Putin wants to end the war'
news.summary: Joining Witkoff, Kushner, Zelensky and European leaders by phone, Trump said Putin is 'getting tired' and urged Merz to call him directly; European officials remain sceptical and another round of talks with Russia may follow next week.

news.headline: Russian missile and drone barrage hits three Kyiv bridges and kills eight across Ukraine
news.summary: Hours after Trump said Putin wants a deal, ballistic and cruise missiles damaged the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges, killed six in Kyiv and two at Lviv's Sknyliv station, and cut power and water in several regions.

news.headline: Poland investigates objects that fell and burned in its south-east during the Russian attack
news.summary: Poland activated air defences and raised alerts in the Lublin and Subcarpathian regions after objects fell near Rudnik nad Sanem and in Bilgoraj county; monitors had tracked a Kh-101 cruise missile heading toward Poland, and no one was hurt.

news.headline: Coalition tells civilians to leave Hodeidah port; Houthis threaten Jeddah and all Saudi Red Sea ports
news.summary: After the Saudi-led coalition warned of strikes on Hodeidah, the Houthis said Saudi Red Sea ports would be targeted, told airlines to avoid Saudi airspace except over Mecca and Medina, and named the Al-Shuqaiq power plant in Jazan as a target.

news.headline: Araghchi says 'the siege must be broken' as IRGC-linked media float a tanker convoy to China
news.summary: Fars proposed sending a convoy of Iranian tankers through the US blockade and warned any attack on it would put UAE, Saudi and Qatari oil terminals in play, after CENTCOM warned ships taking Iranian cargo at sea could be seized.

news.headline: Brent slides toward $90 as Gulf oil exports recover, heading for a third weekly loss
news.summary: Brent fell about 1.8% to $90.33 by mid-morning in Europe after Kpler said Middle East exports reached about 90% of pre-war levels in November, though only around 60% now moves through Hormuz and Iran's own crude exports are near zero.

news.headline: Iraqi forces enter Kataib Hezbollah's Jurf al-Sakhar stronghold after a compromise deal
news.summary: Federal Police took control of the town under a deal giving Kataib Hezbollah about a month to withdraw, with a joint force guarding oil pipelines investigators say were tapped; the group denies stealing oil.

news.headline: Houthis declare Saudi airspace 'unsafe' and tell shipping lines to leave Saudi Red Sea ports
news.source: House of Saud (citing Reuters, Middle East Eye)
news.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said Jeddah and all Saudi Red Sea ports would be targets if Hodeidah was hit and urged shipping companies to evacuate their ships, exempting only the airspace over Mecca and Medina.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition strikes Hodeidah port; Houthis say 41 killed in 24 hours
news.summary: The coalition said a 'special operation' hit weapons-smuggling capabilities at Hodeidah port and targets in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz, and intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles over Jazan; the Houthis said 41 people were killed, a figure not independently confirmed.

news.headline: US wants a Ukraine peace deal by early January, and Europeans fear major concessions, FT reports
news.summary: US negotiators told European and Ukrainian officials the White House wants a deal before Democrats take control of Congress, and a European official said the Americans are 'pushing hard' for Ukrainian concessions.

news.headline: Trump says the US 'will not allow' an Iranian dirty bomb and wants a 'real deal'
news.summary: At a White House press conference Trump said he had heard a 'rumor' that Iran is building a dirty bomb, said Xi and Putin want the Iran war to end, and insisted on a 'real deal' rather than a 'fake' one.

news.headline: Russian double-tap strike on a Kryvyi Rih restaurant kills a 7-year-old and a paramedic
news.summary: Two ballistic missiles hit a restaurant car park in central Kryvyi Rih late on 20 Nov and Shahed drones then struck the same site, killing a seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic and injuring 42.

news.headline: Saudi air defences intercept three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh
news.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed three Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh shortly after 2 a.m. local time on 21 Nov, after alerts in Riyadh, Al-Sulayyil and Najran; two explosions were heard and no casualties were reported.

news.headline: Russia fires three ballistic missiles and 148 drones overnight as homes burn in Kyiv
news.summary: Ukraine's air force said it downed 117 of 148 drones overnight on 21 Nov; debris set private houses on fire in Kyiv's Podil district, and Russian attacks killed at least two and injured 83 across Ukraine in a day.

news.headline: Tanker struck north of Khasab as UKMTO says Hormuz traffic is still 65% below pre-war
news.summary: UKMTO reported a projectile hit the stern of a tanker about 11 nm north of Khasab and a separate report of an engine-room hit 17 nm east of the port, with no casualties; its weekly overview counted 263 transits and six tanker attacks in the week to 18 Nov.

news.headline: Iran readies 14 tankers to run the US blockade and threatens Gulf oil facilities if they are hit
news.summary: MP Vahid Ahmadi said Iran is preparing 14 tankers, possibly with military escorts, to challenge the US naval blockade and warned 'if we cannot sell oil, others should not be able to sell it either'; a deputy speaker said there is 'no alternative to breaking' the blockade.

news.headline: IRGC claims it shot down US MQ-9 and MQ-1 drones over Hormuz and Qeshm
news.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a new air-defence system downed an MQ-9 over the Strait of Hormuz and later an MQ-1 over Qeshm Island; there was no immediate US comment.

news.headline: Israeli strike kills three in Gaza City as Board of Peace adviser threatens to hand Gaza to the UN
news.summary: Palestinian media said an afternoon air strike in Gaza City killed three people after six were killed in Bureij, Deir al-Balah and Nuseirat on 20 Nov, while Board of Peace adviser Josh Gruenbaum said the body would 'hand the keys' to the UN if Israel keeps blocking reconstruction.

news.headline: Rutte in Warsaw says NATO 'will defend every inch' of Poland after Russian missile lands
news.summary: NATO's secretary general visited Warsaw after a Kh-101 cruise missile came down at Nowy Lipowiec and two other objects fell in south-east Poland during Russia's 20 Nov strike, which Prime Minister Tusk called a deliberate provocation.

news.headline: Lebanon's Aoun demands full Israeli withdrawal and tells Hezbollah to hand over its weapons
news.summary: On the eve of independence day, President Aoun told Israel to 'withdraw from every inch' of Lebanon and return detainees, decried interference by parts of the Iranian regime, and said no weapons may sit outside the state, as Israeli strikes hit the Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil and Marjayoun districts.

news.headline: Iran fires missiles and drones at US bases in Bahrain; Bahrain reports a fire at an industrial site
news.summary: The IRGC said it struck two US Patriot radars at the al-Riffa and Awali bases in retaliation for US drone flights over Iran; Bahrain said its air defences intercepted several attacks and one hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries, and neither Bahrain nor the US confirmed damage to the bases.

news.headline: Iran calls the US blockade 'an act of war' as tankers gather off Kharg and three ships are hit near Hormuz
news.summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi said a convoy of more than 14 tankers off Kharg Island would sail for China and warned of a 'fierce military response' if the US engages it, after at least three tankers were attacked in or near the strait on Saturday and explosions were reported in Sirik.

news.headline: Russian drone destroys apartment block in Dymer near Kyiv, killing at least two
news.summary: One of 186 drones Russia launched overnight hit a five-storey building in Dymer, killing at least two and wounding four, with 11 people believed trapped; Ukraine says it downed or suppressed 161 of the drones.

news.headline: UK prepares for possible renewed US strikes on Iran, Bloomberg reports
news.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham and senior ministers have been planning for renewed US strikes, with officials seeing little prospect of a negotiated settlement, according to Bloomberg.

news.headline: Saudi Arabia warns Iran of consequences as Bahrain says two were hurt in Saturday's attacks
news.summary: Riyadh condemned Iran's strike on a civilian industrial site in Bahrain, and Bahrain's Interior Ministry said a Bahraini citizen and a Pakistani resident were injured, the latter critically.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition downs Houthi drone heading for Riyadh
news.summary: The coalition said it intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by the Houthis toward the Riyadh region, a day after three ballistic missiles were fired at the capital.

news.headline: Kaliningrad sounds first air-raid sirens since 2022 as drones set a Russian ship alight off Finland
news.summary: Kaliningrad's governor blamed an object from the direction of Lithuania, which Lithuania denied, while the burning cargo ship Sparta II drifted into Finnish waters after a drone strike both Finland and Russia linked to Ukraine.

timeline.title: Trump confirms US strikes on Qeshm air defences

timeline.title: More tankers hit mines in Hormuz; US disables blockade runner

timeline.detail: Iranian state media report overnight US strikes on Qeshm Island and Iran says a tanker hit a mine east of Hormuz; a drone knocks out Iraq's Khor Mor gas field. After meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump cites 'positive momentum' toward a deal and calls new strikes 'quite unlikely'.
timeline.title: Trump meets Qatar's PM; Iran says US struck Qeshm again

timeline.detail: Oil briefly drops to its lowest since late August on deal hopes, then rebounds as the IRGC says tankers were left burning in Hormuz, UKMTO reports a tanker hit off Oman and ADNOC says a vessel was damaged in UAE waters; Iran denies a Hormuz-for-assets deal and Canada relists 11 Iranian entities.
timeline.title: Brent dips below $90; new tanker attacks around Hormuz

timeline.detail: Israel's security cabinet tells the military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran; Tehran warns it would widen the war to Europe and rejects moving its enriched uranium abroad, as more ships are hit off Oman's Lima.
timeline.title: Israel orders readiness for possible Iran strike

timeline.detail: Trump says the days of a deal with Iran 'have long since passed' and reassigns Vance, who had led outreach to Tehran; Iran threatens a response '10 times' stronger to any attack, and oil climbs back toward $95.
timeline.title: Trump says US doesn't need an Iran deal

timeline.detail: After an 'enemy' strike on Sirik, the IRGC claims it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain; CENTCOM says both drones were shot down. Iran also says an LNG carrier hit a mine in Hormuz.
timeline.title: Iran fires drones at US forces in Bahrain

timeline.detail: Iran says three oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in and east of Hormuz; the White House says Trump will raise Iran at a first meeting with Xi and Putin in Shenzhen next week.
timeline.title: Iran reports three more tankers hit by mines

timeline.detail: The IRGC says six drones targeted a US radar at Riffa, which Bahrain says it intercepted, and says a supertanker carrying 2 million barrels sank after a mine strike.
timeline.title: Iran hits at Bahrain again; claims supertanker sunk

timeline.detail: The USS Theodore Roosevelt joins two other carriers in CENTCOM's area; in Islamabad, Araghchi offers to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade, and two tankers are disabled by fires off the strait.
timeline.title: Third US carrier arrives; Iran offers two-day Hormuz reopening

timeline.detail: US jets hit an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island after IRGC drones target a US radar in Bahrain; a disabled LPG carrier is struck a second time near Khasab, and Araghchi discusses Hormuz shipping in Muscat.
timeline.title: US strikes Qeshm; Tara Gas hit again off Khasab

timeline.detail: Iran's regular army says its drones hit US Patriot systems at Ali Al Salem in retaliation for the Qeshm strike; Kuwait intercepts drones and the GCC, Qatar and UAE condemn the attacks.
timeline.title: Iran's army targets US base in Kuwait

timeline.detail: Trump says he is 'not rushing' and will decide on new strikes after the start of the year, as Iran claims more tankers hit mines near Hormuz.

timeline.title: Government forces quit Bab al-Mandab area

timeline.title: Houthis seize more coast near Aden

timeline.title: Coalition strikes Hodeidah port

timeline.title: Abu Dhabi trilateral talks open

timeline.title: Abu Dhabi talks end with prisoner-swap deal

chokepoints.detail: The Houthis hold the coast overlooking the strait after government forces withdrew from Dhubab on 15 Nov. The coalition struck Hodeidah port on 20 Nov, and the Houthis fired missiles at Jazan and told shipping companies to pull their ships out of Saudi Red Sea ports; most container lines still route Asia–Europe services around the Cape of Good Hope.
chokepoints.name: Bab el-Mandeb
chokepoints.share: Up: Saudi crude rerouted by pipeline to Yanbu on the Red Sea

chokepoints.detail: Commercial traffic moving, but drones hit three merchant ships off Romania's coast near Sulina and Sfântu Gheorghe on 13–14 Nov, after a sea drone struck a container ship off Bulgaria; Odesa port facilities remain under Russian attack.
chokepoints.name: Bosporus & Black Sea lanes
chokepoints.share: Turkish Straits; Caspian and Russian Black Sea crude

chokepoints.detail: Open, carrying diverted Asia–Europe container traffic that would normally use the Red Sea.
chokepoints.name: Cape of Good Hope
chokepoints.share: Not a chokepoint; carries diverted traffic

chokepoints.detail: Open. Elevated NATO presence around undersea cables and Russian naval movements. Live Baltic AIS vessel positions are shown on the globe.
chokepoints.name: Danish Straits (Baltic exit)
chokepoints.share: Main outlet for Russian Baltic crude

chokepoints.detail: Still largely shut to unauthorised traffic, and the IRGC says it remains closed; at least three tankers were attacked in or near the strait on 21 Nov, including one hit about 11 nm north of Khasab, and Iran fired missiles and drones at US bases in Bahrain that night. More than 14 Iranian tankers are gathered off Kharg to run the US blockade, and Iran's own crude exports are near zero; Kpler says only about 60% of Gulf exports now move through Hormuz.
chokepoints.name: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoints.share: 26% of seaborne oil and ~20% of LNG before the war
chokepoints.transits: UKMTO weekly overview, 7 days to 18 Nov: 263 transits (148 inbound, 115 outbound; 73 broadcasting AIS), about 65% below pre-war and down from 308 the week before; IMF PortWatch: 3 AIS-visible transits on 8 Nov vs ~85 a day pre-crisis

chokepoints.detail: No disruption reported in this briefing; carries a large share of Gulf crude bound for Asia, now sharply reduced by the Hormuz closure.
chokepoints.name: Strait of Malacca
chokepoints.share: 29% of seaborne oil before the war; down with lost Gulf supply

chokepoints.detail: No disruption reported in this briefing.
chokepoints.name: Panama Canal
chokepoints.share: Up as US crude and products head to Asia

chokepoints.detail: Volumes remain depressed because of Red Sea diversions; a few carriers have restored Red Sea routings.
chokepoints.name: Suez Canal

chokepoints.detail: Open but under pressure: Taiwan says China massed more than 100 navy and coast guard vessels in unannounced western Pacific drills in early November, about 70 still within the first island chain on 13 Nov. About $1.3T of China's trade and ~$755B of Japanese, Korean and Philippine trade passes through yearly (2024, CSIS).
chokepoints.name: Taiwan Strait

drivers.how: Hormuz oil flows fell from about 21 to 4.9 million barrels a day. The war premium rises with strike threats and falls on diplomacy: Brent dropped ~7% on 2 Nov on peace-talk signals.
Houthi attacks keep Red Sea tanker routing costly; Saudi crude rerouted to Yanbu now relies on Bab el-Mandeb.
Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian refineries and Western sanctions shift refined-product and crude flows.
Iraqi exports depend on Gulf routes; spillover from a resumed US–Iran war would hit southern output.

markets.name: Brent crude
markets.note: Ended 20 Nov near $92.6, recovering from an intraday dip below $91 but still down for a third straight week as ample supply and surplus forecasts outweighed fears of renewed US strikes on Iran.

drivers.how: The DRC is a leading copper producer; instability and state export controls on its mining belt affect supply.

markets.name: Copper
markets.note: Fell about 3% to around $5.47 on 20 Nov, a fresh seven-month low, on doubts over AI data-centre demand and weak Chinese industrial output.

drivers.how: Ukraine is a top corn exporter through its Black Sea ports.
Shipping attacks near Bulgaria and Odesa raise export costs.

markets.name: Corn (CBOT)
markets.note: Fell about 1% to $4.35 on 20 Nov, near its lowest since early July, as a 19-month high in the dollar and weaker crude weigh on grains.

drivers.how: Safe-haven demand rises with escalation risk and fades when talks progress.
A Taiwan crisis would be the largest safe-haven shock on the board.

markets.name: Gold
markets.note: Fell about 2.5% to around $3,535 on 20 Nov, its lowest since September 2025 and its steepest weekly drop in eight months, as markets price a near-certain Fed rate hike in December.

drivers.how: Qatari LNG trapped behind Hormuz forces Asian buyers into the spot market.
Qatar's share of Taiwan's gas imports fell from 33.7% to 10.7% this year, raising its exposure to spot prices.

markets.name: Asian LNG (JKM)
markets.note: Reuters' weekly Asia spot assessment for January delivery fell to $26.90 on 20 Nov from $31.30 a week earlier, a six-week low, as buyers are well stocked and some LNG still moves through Hormuz.
markets.source: Reuters weekly Asia spot LNG assessment (via USO News)

drivers.how: About a fifth of world LNG, mostly Qatari, normally moves through Hormuz; its closure tightens Europe's winter supply.
The EU ban on Russian LNG takes effect on 1 Jan 2027, and energy sanctions stay until the war ends.

markets.name: European gas (TTF)
markets.note: Jumped about 6% to nearly €90 on 20 Nov on lower Norwegian flows after the Troll outage, colder forecasts and EU storage at about 70% against 81% a year ago.

drivers.how: War-risk premiums around Hormuz and ship-to-ship transfer delays in the Gulf tie up tankers and push rates to records.
Sanctions on Russian shadow-fleet tankers shift crude onto mainstream ships.

markets.name: Supertanker rate (VLCC, Gulf–China)
markets.note: TD3C Gulf–China earnings held at about $1.08m a day in the week to 20 Nov as VLCC rates firmed on most routes, still far above pre-war levels as Hormuz risk ties up tankers.

drivers.how: Houthi attacks keep container lines on the longer Cape of Good Hope route, absorbing ship capacity.
Fuel surcharges and Gulf port disruption add to box rates.
A blockade or large drill would disrupt one of the world's busiest container lanes.

markets.name: Container freight (Drewry WCI)
markets.note: Down 3% to $4,176 on 19 Nov, a fourth weekly fall led by transpacific rates; Asia–Europe rates are expected to rise on December surcharges, with most services still routed around Africa.

drivers.how: Ukraine and Russia are major exporters; strikes on Odesa ports threaten shipments.
Attacks on merchant ships raise insurance costs on the main grain export route.

markets.name: Wheat (CBOT)
markets.note: Slipped to about $5.76 on 20 Nov after the International Grains Council raised its 2026/27 world wheat crop forecast by 6 million tonnes to 826 million.

drivers.how: Moves with the Gulf war premium; US crude exports have filled part of the gap left by the Hormuz closure.

markets.name: WTI crude
markets.note: Ended 20 Nov at $83.98 after touching its lowest in almost three months, down for a third straight week as the IEA projects a surplus of about 2 million b/d this quarter.

events.summary: Iran's army said via state media that an oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine in a 'restricted area' of the eastern strait; there was no independent confirmation.
events.title: Iran says tanker hit mine in eastern Hormuz

events.summary: Russia and Ukraine agreed a large-scale prisoner exchange at the end of two days of US-mediated talks, but made no breakthrough on ending the war.
events.title: Abu Dhabi talks end with POW swap deal

events.summary: A Russian strike on a market in central Chornomorsk killed three people and injured 11, four critically, and started a fire.
events.title: Russian strike on Chornomorsk market

events.place: Strait of Hormuz off Lima, Oman
events.summary: Ambrey said a projectile hit a merchant vessel's engine room about 7 nm northeast of Lima, disabling it; no injuries or pollution were reported.
events.title: Merchant ship disabled off Lima, Oman

events.summary: Police sources told AFP that missiles hit coalition camps in western and central Aden.
events.title: Missiles hit coalition camps in Aden

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two drones launched toward the Mecca region and the south, and later intercepted two missiles; the Houthis denied targeting Mecca.
events.title: Houthi drones toward Mecca region destroyed

events.place: Off Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
events.summary: A projectile hit the engine room of the Liberia-flagged tanker Dominica Prosperity about 14 nm northwest of Ras Al Khaimah; all 22 crew were evacuated as firefighting continued.
events.title: Tanker ablaze off Ras Al Khaimah

events.summary: Israeli media reported that the security cabinet told the military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran.
events.title: Israel orders readiness for possible Iran strike

events.summary: Ballistic missiles and drones hit Kyiv overnight, and a drone later set a nine-storey block in Solomianskyi district on fire, killing one and injuring seven.
events.title: Missile and drone attack on Kyiv

events.summary: A Russian drone hit a customs terminal in Kovel, setting trucks and a fuel tanker on fire and injuring one person.
events.title: Drone hits customs terminal in Kovel

events.summary: A Russian drone strike in Kherson early on 12 Nov fatally wounded a woman.
events.title: Drone strike kills woman in Kherson

events.summary: Putin held more than two hours of talks with Witkoff and Kushner on settling the war in Ukraine.
events.title: Putin meets US envoys in Kremlin

events.summary: Iranian state media said the Hormuz-coast town was hit by an unattributed air strike on a telecom tower; no casualties were reported.
events.title: 'Enemy' strike on Sirik

events.summary: Witkoff and Kushner met Zelensky at Casement Aerodrome after their Kremlin talks; Kushner said Europeans must join the next round.
events.title: US envoys brief Zelensky near Dublin

events.summary: The Security Council extended Yemen sanctions to November 2027 and moved to curb Houthi access to drone and missile components.
events.title: UN renews Houthi sanctions

events.summary: Moscow's mayor said 467 drones flew toward the capital region overnight, and Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo, Vnukovo and Zhukovsky airports imposed restrictions.
events.title: Mass drone raid on Moscow region

events.summary: A Russian overnight attack on Rivne wounded six people, including two children, and 42 residents were evacuated.
events.title: Overnight strike wounds six in Rivne

events.summary: A downed drone set fire to a hospital in Shevchenkivskyi district, injuring three and forcing 30 people to evacuate.
events.title: Russian drone sets Kyiv hospital on fire

events.summary: Taiwan says about 70 Chinese navy and coast guard vessels, with the carrier Liaoning, remain inside the first island chain after unannounced drills that peaked at more than 100 ships.
events.title: Chinese fleet massed east of Taiwan

events.summary: The IRGC said it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain; CENTCOM said US forces downed both one-way attack drones with no injuries or damage.
events.title: Iranian drones shot down over Bahrain

events.summary: Four plant workers were killed and fires broke out at the Lukoil refinery in Volgograd's southern industrial zone.
events.title: Volgograd refinery ablaze after drone attack

events.summary: The IRGC navy said a tanker carrying LNG struck a mine and exploded on an 'unauthorised' route; the ship was not named.
events.title: Iran says LNG carrier hit mine in Hormuz

events.summary: Iran's navy said it shot down a US MQ-1 Predator near the Sirik coast; the claim was not independently verified.
events.title: Iran says it downed a US Predator drone

events.summary: Houthi fighters seized strategic hilltops in Al-Madaribah wal Ara district as government forces fortify Aden's western and northern approaches.
events.title: Houthis take hills overlooking Aden

events.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it hit a maintenance hangar, an aviation fuel tank and a command post at the Lipetsk-2 military airfield.
events.title: Ukraine strikes Lipetsk-2 airbase

events.summary: A Russian strike seriously damaged a five-storey building, injuring children, and a rescuer was killed when a concrete slab collapsed during clearance.
events.title: Apartment block hit in Zaporizhzhia

events.summary: A Russian strike hit a private house in Odesa, killing two people and injuring five, two seriously.
events.title: Strike on Odesa house kills two

events.summary: Israeli tank shelling in eastern Deir al-Balah killed three people, including a 12-year-old boy, and wounded 20; Israel said it fired at suspects near the Yellow Line.
events.title: Tank fire kills three in Deir al-Balah

events.summary: Erdogan and Qatar's emir signed a mutual defence agreement in Istanbul.
events.title: Turkey–Qatar defence pact signed

events.summary: At an EU leaders' meeting in Dublin, Costa said the UK, France, Germany, Italy and Poland will join the EU at the next round of talks.
events.title: EU names Europe's Ukraine-talks team

events.summary: Early-morning attacks on three city districts wounded 22 people, including three children, and set an infrastructure facility on fire.
events.title: Russian strikes wound 22 in Zaporizhzhia

events.summary: Iran's IRGC and navy said three unnamed oil tankers, one a supertanker, caught fire after striking mines in the south of the strait and east of it.
events.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz

events.summary: Houthi-run Al Masirah TV reported Saudi-led coalition strikes on southern parts of Saada city.
events.title: Coalition strikes southern Saada

events.summary: The army and allies seized Khamasat, Markab and Umm Oweisha east of RSF-held Al-Nuhud in West Kordofan.
events.title: Army takes areas east of Al-Nuhud

events.summary: An Israeli drone strike in Jabaliya, on the northern edge of Gaza City, killed two Palestinians.
events.title: Israeli drone strike kills two in Jabaliya

events.summary: The coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two Houthi drones launched toward Riyadh and the kingdom's southern region.
events.title: Houthi drones downed over Saudi Arabia

events.summary: Ukraine said several oil tanks were burning at the Samara pumping station near Prosvet, which blends Urals export crude.
events.title: Samara oil pumping station on fire

events.summary: A suspected bomb in a parked car killed a man and his daughter and seriously injured his wife in the Damascus suburb.
events.title: Car bomb kills two in Jaramana

events.summary: An Israeli strike in al-Mawasi near Khan Younis killed Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis.
events.title: Hamas Rafah Brigade commander killed

events.summary: A Russian strike on critical infrastructure in Mena, Chernihiv Oblast, killed two men and injured one.
events.title: Two killed in strike on Mena

events.summary: A Russian drone attack hit a DTEK energy facility, leaving about 41,000 families without power and injuring six.
events.title: Russian strike on Odesa energy site

events.summary: The coalition said it destroyed two ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh and three drones over the Eastern Province.
events.title: Houthi ballistic missiles at Riyadh intercepted

events.summary: Residents reported a drone attack on an industrial site, likely the Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical complex; Ukraine made no official claim.
events.title: Drone attack reported on Nizhnekamsk plant

events.summary: The IRGC said six drones targeted a US air-defence radar at the Riffa helicopter base; Bahrain said its air defences destroyed the attacks.
events.title: Iranian drones at US radar in Bahrain

events.summary: The DRC backed Romania's Dacian Ciolos to block a third term for Rwanda's Louise Mushikiwabo as the summit opened.
events.title: DRC–Rwanda clash at Francophonie summit

events.summary: The Southern Armed Forces redeployed from Dhubab airport and the Bab al-Mandab area toward Aden, leaving the Houthis overlooking the strait.
events.title: Government forces withdraw from Bab al-Mandab area

events.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield, with at least 30 explosions and a fire reported.
events.title: Ukraine strikes Akhtubinsk airbase

events.summary: The ICRC confirmed the Houthis released 600 conflict-related detainees.
events.title: Houthis free 600 detainees

events.summary: Saba reported six civilians, including two children and two women, injured by Houthi artillery and sniper fire in Taiz.
events.title: Houthi shelling wounds six in Taiz

events.summary: The IRGC said an unnamed supertanker carrying 2 million barrels sank after hitting a mine and another tanker caught fire; the claims are unverified.
events.title: Iran says supertanker sank after mine strike

events.summary: The US Embassy in Manama issued a security alert warning of possible attacks by Iran and the Houthis on US interests.
events.title: US Embassy in Bahrain warns of attacks

events.summary: Drones set fire to an oil depot and a gas distribution station in Azov, injuring three men, Rostov's governor said.
events.title: Oil depot ablaze in Azov

events.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said three atmospheric crude units and a gasoline complex at the Ilsky refinery were damaged overnight.
events.title: Ukrainian drones hit Ilsky refinery

events.summary: A Russian attack overnight wounded two people in Pavlohrad, local authorities said.
events.title: Overnight attack wounds two in Pavlohrad

events.summary: A reported strike on a navigable-span arch forced temporary traffic limits on the Kerch bridge; damage is unverified.
events.title: Crimean Bridge reportedly hit

events.summary: Israel said it hit a Hezbollah-bound weapons shipment that had crossed from Syria; Lebanon's NNA reported no casualties.
events.title: Israeli strike in the Bekaa Valley

events.summary: A morning Russian strike on a road in Dnipro killed one person and injured 13, an hour after another strike damaged apartment buildings.
events.title: Strike on Dnipro road kills one, injures 13

events.summary: The Foreign Affairs Council listed 113 people and entities, including 47 banks and major refiners, and sanctioned a Kremlin troll factory and a hacker group.
events.title: EU ministers adopt new Russia sanctions

events.place: Near Abu Zabad, West Kordofan, Sudan
events.summary: Sudan's army says it seized five localities northeast of Abu Zabad from the RSF and advanced toward the town.
events.title: Army takes Al-Saatat areas

events.summary: Military sources say the Houthis took the Khor Omairah coast about 100 km west of Aden and are 25 km from government lines at Qawah.
events.title: Houthis seize coast west of Aden

events.summary: Araghchi said ECO states back Iran's plan to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade; Pakistan awaits a US reply.
events.title: Iran pitches two-day Hormuz plan in Islamabad

events.summary: Estonia summoned Russia's charge d'affaires over an alleged GRU arson attempt on drone maker Threod Systems.
events.title: Estonia summons Russian envoy

events.summary: UKMTO said a tanker about 7 nm north of Khasab was left disabled with an engine-room fire; crew safe.
events.title: Tanker disabled north of Khasab

events.summary: Seven Russian ballistic missiles hit the North and South bridges, closing both and halting the metro's eastern Green Line section.
events.title: Ballistic missiles hit Kyiv's Dnipro bridges

events.summary: Three people were reported injured in Smila, Cherkasy Oblast, during the overnight Russian attack.
events.title: Missile strike on Smila

events.summary: An industrial infrastructure facility was hit and six strikes were reported in the region during the overnight attack.
events.title: Industrial site hit in Zaporizhzhia

events.summary: Trump joined the ASEAN summit's final day before heading to China to meet Xi and Putin.
events.title: Trump arrives in Manila for ASEAN

events.summary: Fires were reported at several points of the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex overnight amid reports of a Ukrainian drone attack; not independently verified.
events.title: Fires at Salavat petrochemical complex

events.summary: A section of the road bridge fell into the Kerch Strait after a reported Ukrainian strike; Russia suspended road and rail traffic.
events.title: Crimean Bridge span collapses

events.summary: The disabled LPG carrier was struck a second time and engulfed in flames; the crew abandoned ship and one seafarer is missing.
events.title: Tara Gas hit again off Khasab

events.summary: Araghchi and Busaidi discussed maritime security and reviving dialogue to prevent escalation.
events.title: Iran and Oman FMs meet on Hormuz

events.summary: The IRGC said it targeted a US radar at the base for the third time since Friday; Bahrain said the drones were intercepted with no casualties.
events.title: IRGC drones at US radar, Sheikh Isa Air Base

events.summary: A US official said fighter jets hit an IRGC missile launch site in self-defence; IRNA reported five or six explosions northwest of Qeshm city.
events.title: US jets strike IRGC missile site on Qeshm

events.summary: Trump said an Iran deal is 'very close' and he will press Xi and Putin to help end the war.
events.title: Trump meets Quad and ASEAN leaders

events.summary: Seven drones crossed into Moldova during Russia's attack on Ukraine, one over Chisinau; five crashed near villages, with no casualties.
events.title: Russian drones enter Moldovan airspace

events.summary: A drone strike the Kordofan Observatory blamed on the army killed at least 16 displaced civilians at a school in Ghabish.
events.title: Drone strike on displaced people's school shelter

events.summary: Putin landed ahead of Thursday's first three-way meeting with Trump and Xi, whose agenda the Kremlin says is agreed.
events.title: Putin arrives in Shenzhen for APEC

events.place: Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait
events.summary: Kuwait's air defences engaged hostile drones and Iran's army said it targeted US Patriot systems at the base in retaliation for the Qeshm strike; damage is unverified.
events.title: Iranian drones target Ali Al Salem air base

events.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels said both Seversky district refineries were struck overnight; Kyiv has not confirmed.
events.title: Drones reportedly hit Ilsky and Afipsky refineries

events.summary: Russian drones damaged Austria's honorary consulate, apartment blocks and a dormitory, injuring six people.
events.title: Drone attack damages Austrian consulate in Dnipro

events.summary: A residential building in the city centre was hit during Russia's overnight drone attack; one person was killed and others injured.
events.title: Strike on central Odesa kills one

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed 60 Houthi military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah, Saada and Amran.
events.title: Coalition hits 60 Houthi targets

events.summary: The coalition said it intercepted a Houthi cruise missile aimed at the Saudi capital as civil defence issued alerts in three regions.
events.title: Houthi cruise missile at Riyadh intercepted

events.summary: The two leaders said China and Russia should lead a push to a multipolar world, a day before the three-way summit with Trump.
events.title: Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen

events.summary: Bahrain's defence force said it responded to several Iranian air attacks; CENTCOM said no US personnel were hurt.
events.title: Bahrain repels new Iranian air attacks

events.summary: The Quds Force commander met Prime Minister al-Zaidi as Baghdad gave Kataib Hezbollah until Friday to leave Jurf al-Nasr.
events.title: Qaani in Baghdad over Jurf al-Nasr standoff

events.summary: Israeli strikes killed three Palestinians; the military said it targeted Hamas militants in Gaza City and Al-Mughraqa.
events.title: Israeli strikes in central Gaza

events.summary: Houthi-run al-Masirah said Saudi air strikes in Ibb province killed at least three people, including a child; the Houthis say the coalition carried out 87 strikes in 24 hours.
events.title: Coalition air strikes in Ibb

events.summary: Demonstrators mourning 13 gas and oil workers killed in a bus crash turned on the government before security forces dispersed them, witnesses said.
events.title: Protest over oil workers' deaths turns anti-government

events.summary: Russian drone debris hit the 11th floor of a 28-storey residential building in Pechersk district, injuring three people in Kyiv and four more in Kyiv Oblast.
events.title: Drone hits Kyiv high-rise

events.place: 6 nm north of Khasab, Musandam, Oman
events.summary: UKMTO said an outbound tanker was struck in the engine room by an unknown projectile about 6 nautical miles north of Khasab; all crew were reported safe.
events.title: Tanker hit north of Khasab

events.summary: Adm. Brad Cooper met Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir in Tel Aviv, followed by a three-way meeting with the Mossad director.
events.title: CENTCOM chief meets Israel's army chief

events.summary: Crimea's Moscow-installed head confirmed a new strike on the bridge just after midnight, two days after a span collapsed.
events.title: Crimean Bridge hit again

events.summary: Ukrainian drones reportedly set the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk ablaze overnight, according to monitoring channels.
events.title: Tatarstan oil pumping station hit

events.place: King Abdullah Financial District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
events.summary: The facade of the 80-storey tower in King Abdullah Financial District was damaged across several floors after a Houthi missile attack the coalition says it intercepted; no casualties reported.
events.title: Riyadh's PIF Tower damaged

events.summary: The first three-way summit agreed on nuclear risk reduction and UN reform but its joint statement left out Ukraine and Iran.
events.title: Trump–Xi–Putin summit

events.summary: The IRGC Navy claimed two supertankers carrying over 4 million barrels exploded on mines near the strait's southern coast; there is no independent confirmation.
events.title: IRGC claims supertankers hit mines

events.summary: Israel said it concluded a ground operation beyond the Yellow Line and reopened Salah al-Din road; about 6,000 people fled the area.
events.title: Israel ends central Gaza incursion

events.summary: Zelensky arrived in Berlin for talks with European officials and Trump's envoys.
events.title: Zelensky in Berlin for talks

events.summary: Israeli airstrikes and shelling hit the Nabatieh area, Qantara and areas near Khiam despite the ceasefire.
events.title: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon

events.summary: A Russian drone raid killed one man and damaged the Dutch and Austrian embassies and St Volodymyr's Cathedral.
events.title: Drones damage embassies in Kyiv

events.summary: The cabinet gave the UAE ambassador 72 hours to leave and recalled its own envoy, accusing Abu Dhabi of an "invasion".
events.title: Somalia expels UAE envoy

events.summary: Russian-installed authorities restricted fuel sales after the Crimean Bridge strikes, and long queues formed at petrol stations.
events.title: Fuel rationing in Sevastopol

events.summary: Ballistic missiles damaged the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges and killed six people, including three water-utility workers.
events.title: Missiles hit three Kyiv bridges

events.summary: Five people were injured and homes, cars, a bank and a store were damaged.
events.title: Drone attack on Dnipro

events.summary: At least four people were injured when a Russian drone struck a hospital in Kharkiv.
events.title: Drone hits Kharkiv hospital

events.summary: A drone attack on a major infrastructure facility cut power to boiler houses, water pumping stations and hospitals; late that evening a ballistic-missile and drone double-tap on a central restaurant car park killed a 7-year-old and a paramedic and injured 42.
events.title: Kryvyi Rih infrastructure hit

events.summary: Two people were killed at Lviv's Sknyliv railway station as cruise missiles also hit an energy facility in the region.
events.title: Strike on Lviv rail station

events.summary: Poland is investigating a suspected airspace violation after objects fell near Rudnik nad Sanem and in Bilgoraj county during the Russian attack on Ukraine; no one was hurt.
events.title: Object falls in south-east Poland

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition told civilians to leave Hodeidah port ahead of strikes; the Houthis told ships to leave and threatened Saudi Red Sea ports.
events.title: Hodeidah port evacuation warning

events.summary: A Russian strike on an energy facility in Odesa oblast left more than 41,000 consumers without power.
events.title: Energy facility hit in Odesa region

events.summary: Federal Police took control of Kataib Hezbollah's stronghold under a deal giving the group about a month to withdraw.
events.title: Iraqi forces enter Jurf al-Sakhar

events.summary: A Russian guided bomb and FPV drone killed one person and injured five in Sloviansk.
events.title: Guided bomb strike on Sloviansk

events.summary: Russian FPV drones struck a tram and the regional administration building in Zaporizhzhia, and 10 people including a child were injured in Kosmichnyi district.
events.title: FPV drones hit Zaporizhzhia city

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition struck what it called weapons-smuggling capabilities at Hodeidah port after an evacuation warning; the Houthis say coalition strikes killed 41 in 24 hours.
events.title: Coalition strikes Hodeidah port

events.summary: Houthi outlet Al-Masirah showed a power station in Mocha damaged by a coalition air raid.
events.title: Power station hit in Mocha

events.summary: The coalition said it hit missile and drone facilities and a main Houthi supply depot in Sanaa.
events.title: Coalition strikes Sanaa missile sites

events.summary: The coalition intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Jazan province, with debris falling in Al-Shuqaiq, where the Houthis said they targeted a power station.
events.title: Houthi missiles intercepted over Jazan

events.summary: Trump said Xi and Putin want the Iran war to end, warned the US would not allow an Iranian dirty bomb, and said Putin wants to end the war in Ukraine.
events.title: Trump briefs on Shenzhen summit

events.summary: Saudi air defences destroyed three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh shortly after 2 a.m.; two explosions were heard and no casualties reported.
events.title: Houthi missiles at Riyadh intercepted

events.summary: Debris from Russian missiles and drones set private houses on fire in Podil and injured two men; damage also reported in Holosiivskyi.
events.title: Ballistic and drone attack on Kyiv

events.summary: UKMTO said a projectile struck the stern of a tanker about 11 nm north of Khasab; a second report described an engine-room hit 17 nm east of the port, with no casualties.
events.title: Tanker hit north of Khasab

events.summary: Adm. Brad Cooper and Sheikh Saud bin Abdulrahman Al Thani discussed closer military cooperation; Qatar did not say whether Iran was discussed.
events.title: CENTCOM chief meets Qatar's defence minister

events.summary: Al Jazeera reported an Israeli air strike on the outskirts of Baraachit, which also came under gunfire at dawn, as strikes hit the Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil and Marjayoun districts.
events.title: Israeli strike near Baraachit

events.summary: The IRGC said it shot down a US MQ-9 over the Strait of Hormuz and an MQ-1 over Qeshm Island; there was no immediate US comment.
events.title: IRGC claims US drones downed

events.summary: Palestinian media said an Israeli air strike in Gaza City killed three people and injured several on Saturday afternoon.
events.title: Air strike kills three in Gaza City

events.summary: NATO's secretary general said the alliance 'will defend every inch of Polish territory' after a Russian Kh-101 came down in south-east Poland.
events.title: Rutte in Warsaw after missile lands

events.summary: President Aoun demanded Israel withdraw from all Lebanese territory and told Hezbollah to hand over its weapons in an independence-eve speech.
events.title: Aoun demands Israeli withdrawal

events.summary: The IRGC claimed strikes on US Patriot radars at the al-Riffa and Awali bases; Bahrain said it intercepted several attacks and one caused a fire at a civilian industrial facility.
events.title: Iranian missiles and drones at US bases in Bahrain

events.summary: Explosions were reported in Sirik in southern Iran after Iran's attacks on Bahrain; the cause was not confirmed.
events.title: Explosions reported in Sirik

events.summary: A Russian drone hit a five-storey building, killing at least two and wounding four, with 11 people feared trapped.
events.title: Drone destroys apartment block in Dymer

events.summary: The Russian-installed Luhansk leader said a civilian was killed and three wounded in occupied Sievierodonetsk.
events.title: Civilian killed in Sievierodonetsk

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi drone launched toward the Riyadh region.
events.title: Houthi drone downed over Riyadh region

events.summary: Sirens sounded in Kaliningrad for the first time since 2022 over an object Russia said came from Lithuania; Lithuania denied involvement.
events.title: Air-raid sirens in Kaliningrad

events.title: Drone strike sets Russian cargo ship ablaze
